summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several updates to regional data. Initially, a request was made to move Latvia from staging to production for a specific company number. Later discussions focused on anomalies in Denmark and follow-ups regarding Lithuania's issues from the 28th/29th.

Regarding country parameters, two new entities (Clear Channel Suomi Oy and Mediateko) were discussed. It was determined that both are related to Finland, with a parameter value of 10 being assigned for both. Furthermore, it was decided to change the default parameter for Latvia to 10.
decisions: Latvia's data was moved from staging to production.
Clear Channel Suomi Oy and Mediateko parameters were set to 10 (Finland).
The default parameter for Latvia was changed to 10.
